integrity: The mathematical statements have a self-review only; no independent validation or historical-priority certification is claimed. The source date is that of the earliest verified motivating paper, not a publication date for this finding.
scientific_limitations: Does not cover unequal parameters, weighted edges, or continuum metric graphs. The two-term asymptotic runs only along orders for which quadrangles exist. The code supports finite cases; generality rests on analytical proofs. Historical priority remains qualified.
scientific_scope: Finite unit-edge point-line incidence graph of every existing generalized quadrangle of order (q,q), integer q >= 2; p-negative type and Hilbert snowflakes, not continuous edge metrics.
title: Exact negative-type threshold of generalized-quadrangle incidence metrics
